name: The Guts! 5
source:
One year after events of Guts 3.
This time there's large scale road construction that passes through the mountain. Multiple companies participate in this plan realization. If workers from different companies shared responsibilities, then construction would not be done in time. And this is where protagonist with his management skills shows up.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
故事發生在《Guts 3》事件的一年後。這次有一條穿過山區的大型道路建設工程。多家公司參與了這個專案的實施。如果不同公司的工人們無法分擔責任，工程就無法按時完成。就在這時，擁有管理能力的主角登場了。

［出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]］
